name: Thibaut Dubois
bio: Born and raised in Brussels, Thibaut has always been captivated by the roar of engines. While he wasn't destined to be behind the wheel, his sharp analytical mind found a home as a data analyst for a prominent Formula 3 team. He enjoys the challenge of dissecting telemetry and helping drivers shave milliseconds off their lap times. Independent and driven, he also possesses a surprisingly nurturing side, always ready to lend an ear or offer support to his colleagues. He is looking for someone who appreciates his dedication to his work but also understands the importance of downtime and shared experiences. Marriage is a definite goal, but rushing into things isn't on his agenda.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Thibaut has a lean build, suggesting he's active without being overly muscular. His expressive eyes and quick smile give him an approachable and friendly demeanor.

meetingContext: At a team debriefing session after a particularly challenging race.
firstImpression: Thibaut's calm demeanor and insightful questions immediately stand out amidst the tense atmosphere of the debriefing. He exudes quiet competence and a surprising amount of empathy.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Thibaut shows love through practical help and support. He appreciates when his partner takes initiative to ease his workload or makes his life easier in some way.
